facts: Parties: Vantage Robotics Ltd (Buyer), Netherby Technologies Ltd (Seller); the Company is Fenwick Engineering Ltd.
This Agreement is dated 27 September 2026; Closing is scheduled for 4 January 2027 (the 'Closing Date').

Section 9.4 (De Minimis and Basket): the Seller shall not be liable unless the aggregate of all claims exceeds $200,000 (1.0% of the Purchase Price), in which case the Seller shall be liable only for the excess over that amount.
Section 3.4 (Earn-out): the Earn-out Payment equals 3 times the amount by which FY2026 EBITDA exceeds $6,500,000, capped at $5,000,000.
Section 9.7: the Buyer must notify any warranty claim within 30 days of becoming aware of it.
Section 2.3: the Purchase Price shall be reduced dollar-for-dollar by any shortfall of Closing Working Capital below the Target Working Capital of $3,500,000.

Section 1.1: 'Material Adverse Change' means any event which has a material adverse effect on the business of the Company, excluding changes in general economic conditions, changes affecting the industry generally, and pandemics.
Management accounts show FY2026 EBITDA of $7,800,000; the Seller says the Earn-out Payment will therefore be $4,500,000.
The estimated Closing Working Capital is $2,590,000. The Seller's draft funds flow shows an adjusted purchase price of $18,180,000.
Clause 5.2: a claim against the Escrow Amount must be notified within 60 days of the Buyer becoming aware of it.
